title: Super Admin overview drops duplicate Admin KPIs
summary: Super Admin overview no longer repeats the Admin day-to-day KPI cards. It shows Super Admin–only metrics for plugins, median closure, and plugin alerts, while Admin overview keeps the existing account and workload KPIs.
changes: Remove the duplicated Admin account and workload KPI strip from Super Admin overview.
Keep Super Admin overview KPIs to enabled plugins, median closure, and plugin alert count.
version_rationale: Patch release: removes duplicate Super Admin KPI cards without changing Admin metrics or Super Admin charts and tables.
validation: PHPUnit AdminAnalyticsDashboardTest asserts each data-kpi appears once per page and that Super Admin does not render Admin day-to-day KPI keys.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Super Admin still shows account identity tables and workload charts below the KPI strip; only the duplicated day-to-day KPI cards were removed.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the Admin day-to-day KPI cards on Super Admin overview.
provenance: Duplicate Admin/Super Admin KPI cleanup for issue #141, pull request #236.
